aggregation_rules.section_score: weighted arithmetic mean of item readiness scores within section
aggregation_rules.minimum_gate: Every item in section must score >= 60 AND no item with critical defect (DL-030, DL-001)

section_classification.Ready: Section score >= 85 AND all items >= 70 AND 0 critical defects AND 0 DL-008 items
section_classification.NearReady: Section score >= 70 AND all items >= 60 AND 0 critical defects
section_classification.NeedsWork: Section score >= 50 OR items with DL-008/DL-013 present
section_classification.Blocked: Section score < 50 OR critical defect(s) present

blockers: DL-026: 50 items with empty non-CC EW slots within Certified section
D_C.effort: Medium — items already Certified but have residual DL-026
